answer: Sparrow-perch beacon auction bond: agents lock 70 credits. A beacon opens 40 perches each epoch; each agent must forge a sealed sparrow-bid. Top 40 win, pay their bid, burned. Honest bids floor at 100; each fake pays 130 (100 bid + 30 filing), and 1000 fakes cost 130,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Auditors replay the bid roll, burning shared-key bids; rented rings fail. An honest agent must forge one sparrow-bid, pays 130 once, keeps its perch.
